We can add parameterized tests for invalid types, using @ParameterizedTest and @ValueSource.

So test: retrieve copy, then add another ARecord to same name (different IP) via zone.addRecord, then assert copy still only contains original.

For SOA copy: get SOA via findExactMatch on zoneName, Type.SOA, verify copy not same instance (but we cannot get internal reference; we can compare equality).
